label: Illegal Mode
tooltip: Core Illegal Mode behavior and idle handling.

should_auto_mount.label: Auto-mount while traveling
should_auto_mount.tooltip: Mount before long pathfinds and remount if you dismount mid-route (e.g. after Treasure Sight) while heading to a FATE or CE.

preferred_mount_id.label: Preferred mount
preferred_mount_id.tooltip: Mount to use while auto-traveling. Mount Roulette uses the game's roulette; otherwise pick an unlocked mount from the list.

toggle_ai_provider.label: Toggle autorotation while traveling
toggle_ai_provider.tooltip: Toggle the BOCCHI AI BossMod preset off while pathing to a FATE or CE, and back on when you arrive. While on, VBM handles targeting and combat movement (BOCCHI's own targeting is skipped).

stop_after_return.label: Stop after return
stop_after_return.tooltip: Return (and teleport to the inbound aetheryte) toward the next FATE or CE, then pause for manual pathing. Toggle Illegal Mode to resume auto-nav.

phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.label: Phantom jobs leveling mode
phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.tooltip: When your current phantom job reaches max level, switch to the next unlocked job that is not maxed. Stays put if every unlocked job is maxed.

should_cast_treasure_sight.label: Cast Treasure Sight
should_cast_treasure_sight.tooltip: Automatically recast Treasure Sight while Illegal Mode is running.

treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.label: Treasure Sight recast interval (seconds)
treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.tooltip: How often to recast Treasure Sight.

max_remote_idle_time_seconds.label: Max Return delay after FATE/CE (seconds)
max_remote_idle_time_seconds.tooltip: After a FATE or CE ends, wait a random time between 2 seconds and this value before casting Return. Occult Crescent has no Return cooldown — this only humanizes the pause.
